summary: Control Room FASE 3, tested end to end (backend and UI). Backend: 21 of 21 tests pass in the new test_controlroom_phase3_itv.py. It covers: create validation (400); 10 parallel creations giving unique consecutive INT codes; the full status flow (409 for incoherent moves or a stale version; force needs the responsabile plus a note; annullato needs a motivo; chiuso is reserved to the responsabile; reopen needs a motivo; t_* timestamps; history and diary rows); assign → non_confermata and resource impegnato; external polizia vehicle needs conferma_esterni; central confirm via radio (a second confirm gives 409); revoke releases the resource only when it has no other open intervention; overlaps; KPIs; mobile invite, home and checkin; client_id idempotency (duplicate:true); report without GPS (manual) flagged da_confermare; priority ignored without can_set_priority; conferma/partito/arrivato/risolto; rifiuta needs a note; action on a closed intervention → 409; photo PNG 200, text/plain 415, >8MB 413; attachment GET without auth 401; revoked, expired or invalid token 401; message delivered count rises only after the mobile GET and read only after /messages/read; no-recipient messages; inbound unread then reset; notifications unread then reset; roles (members and PUT roles responsabile-only; coordinatore scoped to sector S1, cannot force; visualizzatore 403); health notes; diary filter, CSV export and tenant isolation (org B 404). Edge suite test_controlroom_phase3_edge.py: 2 of 4 pass. Cross-org mobile token → 404 on action and photo. The 2 failures are real bugs (see below). Phase 1 and 2 regression: 39 of 39 pass after updating the old org/event IDs and 2 obsolete Phase-2 intervention tests to the new Phase-3 schema. UI desktop 1920: critical banner, + NUOVO INTERVENTO dialog (11 types, priority, reference → 'da confermare', toast, detail opens), 'Intervento qui' on the map (coords prefilled, origine=mappa), table/card toggle, code search, KPI strip, detail status buttons up to CHIUSO then RIAPRI and ANNULLATO via prompt, ASSEGNA, central radio confirm, comms (delivered 0/1, read 0/1, 'nessun destinatario' flag), diary (115 rows, CSV download), settings itv types (11), access dialog (invite + QR + link shown once + revoke list), sound toggle (OFF by default), bell. UI mobile 390: /cr/op/{token} has no horizontal overflow; SONO IN POSTAZIONE; INVIA SEGNALAZIONE with manual position; double-tap submit created only 1 intervention (INT-037); I MIEI INTERVENTI actions and RIFIUTA with motivo; messages both ways. Dashboard on mobile shows FAB cr-fab-new-itv and opens the dialog. No JS page errors.

critical.issue: Operator gets stuck if the centrale confirms the assignment (radio/telefono) while the intervention is still SEGNALATO. The mobile CONFERMA button is only shown while the assignment is non_confermata, so it disappears. PARTITO then returns 409 'Azione non coerente con lo stato attuale (segnalato)', because segnalato→squadra_inviata is not in FLOW. Reproduced in test_partito_after_central_confirm_on_segnalato. Fix: in m_action, when the state is segnalato/in_attesa, auto-step to preso_in_carico before partito/arrivato. Alternatively, show CONFERMA whenever stato is segnalato/in_attesa.

minor.issue: Sector scope bypass. A coordinatore scoped to S1 can edit their intervention and set km/sector_id/post_id to another sector (S2): 200, and sector_id becomes S2. edit_itv only checks can_itv on the current intervention, not on the new resolved position. Add the same check as in new_itv: pos['sector_id'] in pm['sectors'] for coordinatore.

Non-atomic side effect. An incoherent action (e.g. ARRIVATO on a SEGNALATO intervention with a non_confermata assignment) first marks the assignment 'confermata' (plus a diary row) and only then returns 409. Validate the target transition before calling set_asg.

Close/annul releases the resource (it goes back to disponibile), but the assignment keeps stato non_confermata/confermata. After a reopen, the intervention shows an active assignment (senza_squadra=false) while the resource is disponibile, so the two are inconsistent. Either set assignments to 'chiusa' on close, or set the resources back to impegnato on reopen.
Only mobile invites with role coordinatore become recipients. CRMEvent users with the CR role 'coordinatore' get no notification.
Does not check that the intervention exists (it returns an empty list for any iid). Low impact.
By design (operational log). Test interventions were annulled with motivo 'TEST cleanup', not deleted, so org A now has about 35 annulled TEST interventions (INT-005..INT-037).

ui_bugs.issue: PARTITO / ARRIVATO SUL POSTO / INTERVENTO RISOLTO are always shown, whatever the state. Examples: ARRIVATO on SEGNALATO, and PARTITO/ARRIVATO still shown on an intervention that is already RISOLTO. Tapping an incoherent one only shows the 409 toast. Show only the next valid action(s) for the current stato.
cr-notif-list does not close on outside click or Escape, only by clicking the bell again. It stays open over the Comunicazioni and Diario views and the settings dialog.

issues: With 4+ interventions, the tab row Risorse/Postazioni/Settori/Interventi/Avvisi wraps at 1920 and 'Avvisi N' moves onto a second line.

Motivo for annullamento/riapertura/forzatura/rifiuto and the AGGIORNA text are collected with native window.prompt. A shadcn dialog with a textarea would look more consistent and work better on mobile.
The Interventi table is cut at the right edge (inner horizontal scroll, the page itself does not overflow). The card view is better on mobile: consider making it the default below sm.

action_items: HIGH: fix the mobile flow when the assignment is confirmed centrally while the intervention is SEGNALATO. PARTITO/ARRIVATO now give 409 and the operator has no CONFERMA button. Auto-advance to preso_in_carico, or keep CONFERMA visible.
Enforce the coordinatore sector scope in PUT /interventions/{iid} on the new position/sector.
m_action: validate the transition before confirming the assignment (no partial side effects on a 409).
OperatorMobile: render only the valid next actions per stato.
Make close/reopen and the assignment state consistent.
Close cr-notif-list on outside click / Escape.
Add the 'Control Room Fase 2/3' section (test_cr_a/b/c, org A/event ids) to /app/memory/test_credentials.md. It is currently missing from the file.
critical_code_review_comments: controlroom_itv.py is 784 lines (>700): split mobile endpoints (/cr-mobile) and messaging into separate modules.
extra() (called on every GET /ops poll) writes to the DB (late_notified + notifications): side effects inside a read endpoint that is polled.
edit_itv: missing coordinatore scope check on the target sector (see the bug).
m_action: set_asg runs before the FLOW validation, so a rejected action is not atomic.
send_msg 'coordinatori' ignores CR-role users; the 'squadra' to_type behaves exactly like 'operatore'.
Pydantic validation runs before the permission check, so a visualizzatore sending an invalid body gets 422 instead of 403 (acceptable).

rca of the issue: Mobile stuck: FLOW['segnalato'] = {preso_in_carico, in_attesa, annullato}. m_action only moves to preso_in_carico on the 'conferma' action, and OperatorMobile only renders CONFERMA when my_assignment.stato == non_confermata. confirm_central changes the assignment to confermata without changing the intervention state, so the state stays segnalato and the operator's PARTITO (squadra_inviata) is rejected with 409. Repro: create an intervention → assign R → POST assignments/R/confirm {via: radio} → mobile action partito → 409.
